title: Fix ROE authorization checkbox not handled in _launch_guided_mission_from_preview test helper
goal: In both test files, update the _launch_guided_mission_from_preview helper to also handle the wizard-roe-authorization-checkbox case. After advancing to step 4, before clicking Create Mission, check if the button is disabled and if the wizard-roe-authorization-checkbox is present and unchecked — if so, check it. This is the correct product behavior (authorization must be acknowledged) so the fix is in the tests, not the wizard.
scope: After backlog-120 added the ROE gate, the wizard shows an authorization checkbox (wizard-roe-authorization-checkbox) when a new mission is created without an ROE reference. The Create Mission button stays disabled until the checkbox is checked. The _launch_guided_mission_from_preview helper in both test_operator_console_e2e.py and test_product_feature_matrix_e2e.py handles the 'wizard-full-authorization-input' (typed target confirmation) case but NOT the 'wizard-roe-authorization-checkbox' case. This causes over 30 E2E tests to fail with TimeoutError: Locator.click: Timeout 15000ms exceeded on [data-wizard-create-mission=true] because the button is disabled.

inputs.root_cause: needsRoeAuthorizationConfirmation() in wizard.js returns true when no roe_ref is provided and no authorization_confirmed_at exists on the engagement. The Create Mission button gets disabled=true. The test helpers do not check for or click the 'wizard-roe-authorization-checkbox' to enable the button before clicking.
